newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo declares 8 bln peso highway fund.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo declares 8 bln peso highway fund.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo on Tuesday presented a new 8.0 billion peso fund for highway infrastructure, to be funding through income from privatizations.

"Today I decided that part of the income that is being and will be generated through the Communications and Transport Ministry privatizations will be used to create a highway infrastructure fund," Zedillo said at a presentation of the 1998-2000 Highway Program at this coastal resort and fishing town
Zedillo said the project will require "an investment of 8.0 billion pesos in real terms."
He added that the fund could begin this year with 4.0 billion pesos from the privatization of the Northeast railway, completed on Monday.
The funds will be destined to 10 routes, that will either be new portions or repairs on the nation's 10 largest freeways.
